title: An alternative proof of the upper bound for the generalised Erdős box problem
summary: In this article, we present an alternative proof of the classical theorem of Erdős on the Turán numbers of complete $r$-partite $r$-uniform hypergraphs. More precisely, we establish that for finite sets $A_{1},\ldots,A_{r}$ with $|A_{1}|\leq\cdots\leq|A_{r}|$ and sufficiently large positive integer $n$, \[ \mathrm{ex}(n,\mathbb{K}^{(r)}[A_{1},\ldots,A_{r}]) =O\left(n^{r-\frac{1}{|A_{1}|\cdots|A_{r-1}|}}\right). \] Our approach develops a framework based on repeated applications of Hölder's inequality and the enumeration of configurations through multiple sums. The method combines the principle of inclusion--exclusion with a discrete analogue of Fubini's theorem, yielding recursive estimates for extremal quantities. This provides an alternative proof of Erdős's classical upper bound and offers a unified perspective on the generalized Erdős box problem.

AI.tldr: 本文给出了Erdős关于完全$r$-部$r$-一致超图Turán数上界定理的一个新证明。
AI.motivation: Erdős box问题是极值图论中的经典问题，其Turán数上界已有已知证明，但寻找更简洁或统一的证明方法仍有意义。本文旨在提供一种基于Hölder不等式和多重求和枚举的替代证明，为广义Erdős box问题提供统一视角。
AI.method: 主要技术包括反复应用Hölder不等式、多重求和枚举配置、容斥原理以及Fubini定理的离散类比，从而得到极值量的递归估计。
AI.result: 对于有限集$A_{1},\ldots,A_{r}$满足$|A_{1}|\leq\cdots\leq|A_{r}|$和充分大的正整数$n$，有\[ \mathrm{ex}(n,\mathbb{K}^{(r)}[A_{1},\ldots,A_{r}]) =O\left(n^{r-\frac{1}{|A_{1}|\cdots|A_{r-1}|}}\right). \]
AI.conclusion: 该结果重新证明了Erdős的经典上界，并提供了一个统一的方法来处理广义Erdős box问题，加深了对超图Turán数的理解。
AI.future_work: 论文未明确提及开放问题，但自然延伸包括改进下界或将该方法应用于其他超图极值问题，如非对称情形或更一般的超图结构。

title: Supersaturation in Nosal graphs: Triangles and books
summary: In this paper, we use the spectral surplus $λ(G) - \sqrt{m}$ to measure how far $G$ lies above the Nosal threshold, and prove the following edge-spectral supersaturation results for triangles and books. (a) Every graph $G$ with $m\ge 3$ edges and $λ(G) \ge 1 + \sqrt{m-2}$ contains at least $m-2$ triangles, with equality if and only if $G = K_3 \vee \tfrac{m-3}{3} K_1$. This can be viewed as the third-layer supersaturation in the jump phenomenon, after the first layer $t(G) \ge \lfloor \tfrac{1}{2}(\sqrt{m}-1) \rfloor$ proved by Ning and Zhai, and the second layer $t(G) \ge \tfrac{m-1}{2}$ by Zhang and Zhai. (b) Every $m$-edge graph $G$ satisfies $t(G) \ge m\bigl(λ- \sqrt{m}\,\bigr)$, with equality if and only if $G$ is complete bipartite. Consequently, $λ(G) \ge \sqrt{m} + q$ forces $t(G) > q m$ for every real $q > 0$. This is an edge-spectral counterpart of the Lovász--Simonovits theorem, and it improves the Bollobás--Nikiforov bound $t(G) \ge \tfrac13 λ(λ^2 - m)$ in the range $\sqrt m \le λ(G) \le 1.3\sqrt m $. (c) Every $m$-edge Nosal graph $G$ contains a book of size greater than $\tfrac14 \sqrt{m}$. This improves two recent results on the booksize constant: $\tfrac{1}{24}$ proved by Li, Liu and Zhang, and $\tfrac19$ by Zhai, Li and Lou. This narrows the gap toward the conjectured optimal constant $\tfrac13$. (d) Every $m$-edge Nosal graph $G$ contains at least $\bigl(\tfrac{1}{8} - o(1)\bigr) m$ copies of the kite $C_4^+=B_2$, and the constant $\tfrac18$ is best possible. This determines the sharp asymptotic constant for counting $C_4^+$ and strengthens the $Ω(m)$ bound of Li, Liu and Zhang.
comment: 31 pages, 1 figure. Spectral extremal graph theory

AI.tldr: 利用谱盈余 $\lambda(G) - \sqrt{m}$ 度量图在 Nosal 阈值之上的程度，证明了三角形和书的边-谱超饱和结果，包括三角形计数下界、Lovász–Simonovits 定理的边-谱对应、书大小的改进以及风筝 $C_4^+$ 计数的精确渐近常数。
AI.motivation: Nosal 图（满足 $\lambda(G) \ge \sqrt{m}$ 的图）是谱极值图论的核心对象。已知 Nosal 定理保证存在三角形，但超饱和问题（即三角形数量的精确下界）尚未完全解决。本文旨在利用谱盈余这一精细度量，建立从第一层到第三层的三角形超饱和跳跃现象，并推广到书和风筝等子图，填补了谱超饱和与经典极值结果（如 Lovász–Simonovits 定理）之间的空白。
AI.method: 主要运用谱方法（如 Rayleigh 商、特征值扰动）、极值图论中的结构分析（如完全二部图、$K_3 \vee \tfrac{m-3}{3} K_1$ 的刻画）、以及计数技巧（如通过谱界推导子图计数）。具体地，利用 $\lambda(G)$ 与 $m$ 的关系导出三角形下界，并通过等式条件刻画极图。
AI.result:
(a) 对 $m\ge 3$ 且 $\lambda(G) \ge 1+\sqrt{m-2}$ 的图 $G$，有 $t(G) \ge m-2$，等号成立当且仅当 $G = K_3 \vee \tfrac{m-3}{3} K_1$。
(b) 对任意 $m$ 边图 $G$，$t(G) \ge m(\lambda - \sqrt{m})$，等号成立当且仅当 $G$ 是完全二部图；从而 $\lambda(G) \ge \sqrt{m}+q$ 蕴含 $t(G) > q m$。
(c) 每个 $m$ 边 Nosal 图 $G$ 包含大小大于 $\tfrac14\sqrt{m}$ 的书，改进了常数 $\tfrac{1}{24}$ 和 $\tfrac19$。
(d) 每个 $m$ 边 Nosal 图 $G$ 包含至少 $(\tfrac18 - o(1))m$ 个风筝 $C_4^+$，且 $\tfrac18$ 是最优常数。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果建立了谱超饱和的层次结构，将三角形计数从已知的 $\lfloor \tfrac12(\sqrt{m}-1)\rfloor$ 和 $\tfrac{m-1}{2}$ 提升到 $m-2$，并给出了边-谱版本的 Lovász–Simonovits 定理，改进了 Bollobás–Nikiforov 界。对于书和风筝，结果逼近了猜想的最优常数，展示了谱方法在子图计数中的强大威力。
AI.future_work: 文中提到书大小的最优常数猜想为 $\tfrac13$，目前结果 $\tfrac14$ 仍有差距。此外，对于一般子图（如 $K_r$）的谱超饱和问题，以及更精细的谱条件（如 $\lambda(G) \ge \sqrt{m} + \epsilon$）下的计数下界，都是自然延伸。

title: Treewidth of Products of Graphs with High Treewidth
summary: Treewidth is the standard measure for how ``tree-like'' a graph is. This paper studies how the treewidth of a product graph depends on the treewidth of its factors. Kozawa, Otachi, and Yamazaki [2014] and Hickingbotham and Wood [2025] independently showed that $\text{tw}(G\boxtimes H)\geq (\text{tw}(G)+1)\text{had}(H)-1$ for all graphs $G$ and $H$, where $\text{had}(H)$ is the Hadwiger number of $H$. We improve this bound to $\text{tw}(G\boxtimes H)\geq (\text{tw}(G)+1)(\text{tw}(H)+1)-1$, thereby solving an open problem of Hickingbotham and Wood. We also prove analogous product inequalities for pathwidth, Cartesian products, and strict bramble number, which is a parameter that is tied to treewidth. As an application of our results, we show that products of expanders have large subgraphs that are expanders.

title: Linear Turán Numbers of Uniform Hypertrees
summary: A hypergraph is \emph{linear} if every pair of vertices is contained in at most one hyperedge. For a family $\mathcal{F}$ of $r$-uniform hypergraphs, the linear Tur'an number $ex^{\mathrm{lin}}_r(n,\mathcal{F})$ is the maximum number of hyperedges in an $n$-vertex $\mathcal{F}$-free linear $r$-uniform hypergraph. Extending the work of Gy'arf'as, Ruszink'o, and S'ark"ozy on $3$-uniform linear hypertrees, we study linear Tur'an numbers for higher uniformity. We determine the linear Tur'an number of the $r$-uniform linear star $S_k^r$, proving [ex^{\mathrm{lin}}_r(n,S_k^r)\le \frac{n(k-1)}{r},] with equality exactly for $(k-1)$-regular linear $r$-uniform hypergraphs, whenever they exist. We also construct dense $T_k^r$-free hypergraphs showing that, under suitable divisibility and design-existence assumptions, [ex^{\mathrm{lin}}_r(n,T_k^r)\ge \frac{n(k-1)}{r}] for every linear $r$-uniform hypertree $T_k^r$ with $k$ hyperedges. We then study all linear hypertrees with four hyperedges. For the broom $B_4^r$, we prove [ex^{\mathrm{lin}}_r(n,B_4^r)\le \frac{(r+1)n}{r},] and characterize the extremal hypergraphs as disjoint unions of Steiner systems $S(2,r,r^2)$, whenever such systems exist. For the crown $E_4^r$, we establish [ex^{\mathrm{lin}}_r(n,E_4^r)\le \frac{(2r-1)n}{r},] together with a lower-bound construction leaving only a constant-factor gap. For the linear path $P_4^r$, we construct $P_4^r$-free hypergraphs with $(r+1)n/r$ hyperedges and conjecture this is the optimal general bound. We verify the conjecture for connected hypergraphs under suitable degree conditions. Finally, for $r=4$, we identify counterexamples to a key structural claim in a previous proof of Zhang and Wang, give a new proof that [ex^{\mathrm{lin}}_4(n,P_4^4)\le \frac{5n}{4},] and show that equality holds precisely for disjoint unions of Steiner systems $S(2,4,16)$.
comment: A preliminary version of this work appeared in the proceedings of the International Workshop on Combinatorial Algorithms (IWOCA 2026) http://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-3-032-27732-9_2. This paper is a substantially extended version of the conference paper

AI.tldr: 本文研究了均匀线性超图的Turán数，确定了线性星$S_k^r$的精确极值，并给出了线性树$T_k^r$的下界，同时完全解决了四边线性超树（扫帚、皇冠、路径）的极值问题。
AI.motivation: 线性超图是超图理论中的重要结构，其Turán数问题在组合设计、极值图论中有广泛应用。Gyárfás等人已解决3-均匀线性超树的Turán数，但更高一致性的情形尚未系统研究。本文填补了这一空白，并修正了之前关于4-均匀线性路径的证明错误。
AI.method: 主要使用了构造性方法（如Steiner系统）、极值图论中的正则引理思想、以及针对不同超树结构的组合计数论证。具体包括：利用$(k-1)$-正则线性超图构造极值结构；通过设计Steiner系统$S(2,r,r^2)$达到扫帚的极值；对皇冠和路径采用下界构造和上界证明。
AI.result:
1. 线性星$S_k^r$的线性Turán数：$ex^{\mathrm{lin}}_r(n,S_k^r)\le \frac{n(k-1)}{r}$，等号成立当且仅当超图为$(k-1)$-正则线性$r$-均匀超图。
2. 对任意$k$边线性树$T_k^r$，在适当整除条件下$ex^{\mathrm{lin}}_r(n,T_k^r)\ge \frac{n(k-1)}{r}$。
3. 扫帚$B_4^r$：$ex^{\mathrm{lin}}_r(n,B_4^r)\le \frac{(r+1)n}{r}$，极值超图为Steiner系统$S(2,r,r^2)$的不交并。
4. 皇冠$E_4^r$：$ex^{\mathrm{lin}}_r(n,E_4^r)\le \frac{(2r-1)n}{r}$，且存在下界构造。
5. 线性路径$P_4^r$：构造了具有$(r+1)n/r$条边的$P_4^r$-自由超图，并猜想这是最优上界；对$r=4$证明了$ex^{\mathrm{lin}}_4(n,P_4^4)\le \frac{5n}{4}$，等号成立当且仅当Steiner系统$S(2,4,16)$的不交并。
AI.conclusion: 本文系统推进了均匀线性超树Turán数的研究，确定了多种结构的精确极值，揭示了Steiner系统在极值构造中的核心作用。结果深化了对线性超图极值现象的理解，并为更高一致性的问题提供了方法和猜想。
AI.future_work: 论文提出线性路径$P_4^r$的上界猜想，并指出对于一般$r$的$P_4^r$极值问题尚未解决。此外，对于皇冠$E_4^r$，上下界之间存在常数因子差距，需要进一步精确化。更一般地，所有线性超树的Turán数是否都形如$\frac{n(k-1)}{r}$（在整除条件下）仍是开放问题。

title: Variations on a circular Hessenberg pair
summary: A square matrix is called Hessenberg whenever each entry below the subdiagonal is zero and each entry on the subdiagonal is nonzero. A Hessenberg pair is an ordered pair of diagonalizable linear maps on a nonzero finite-dimensional vector space, that each act on an eigenbasis of the other one in a Hessenberg fashion. A Hessenberg system $Φ$ an `oriented' version of a Hessenberg pair. It is known that $Φ$ is determined up to isomorphism by its parameter array; this consists of the eigenvalue sequence of $Φ$, the dual eigenvalue sequence of $Φ$, and a sequence of nonzero scalars $\{φ_i\}_{i=1}^d$ called the split sequence of $Φ$. We are interested in some types of Hessenberg matrices, said to be circular, quasi-circular, tridiagonal, and irreducible tridiagonal. We are interested in the families of Hessenberg systems for which the associated Hessenberg matrices have one of the above types. A Hessenberg system of irreducible tridiagonal type is often called a Leonard system. In this case the associated Hessenberg pair satisfies two relations, called the tridiagonal relations. We are interested in the family of Hessenberg systems for which the associated Hessenberg pair satisfies the tridiagonal relations. We are also interested in the family of Hessenberg systems for which the eigenvalue sequence and dual eigenvalue sequence satisfy a linear three-term recurrence. In the present paper we have two main goals. First, we show how the above families of Hessenberg systems are related to each other. Second, we describe each family in terms of the parameter array.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Hessenberg pair和Hessenberg system的各种变体，包括circular、quasi-circular、tridiagonal和irreducible tridiagonal类型，并揭示这些家族之间的关系以及用参数数组描述它们。
AI.motivation: Hessenberg pair和Hessenberg system是线性代数中的重要概念，与Leonard system（即不可约三对角型）密切相关。Leonard system在正交多项式、关联方案和量子群中有广泛应用。本文旨在系统研究这些系统的不同变体，填补关于circular和quasi-circular类型以及满足三对角关系的Hessenberg系统的分类和关系方面的空白。
AI.method: 主要使用线性代数方法，包括特征值序列、对偶特征值序列和分裂序列的参数数组分析。通过定义circular、quasi-circular、tridiagonal和irreducible tridiagonal等矩阵类型，并利用三对角关系（tridiagonal relations）和线性三递推关系来刻画这些家族。
AI.result:
设$\Phi$是一个Hessenberg system，参数数组为$(\{\theta_i\}_{i=0}^d, \{\theta^*_i\}_{i=0}^d, \{\phi_i\}_{i=1}^d)$。本文证明了：
- $\Phi$是circular型当且仅当$\theta_i = \theta_0 + c i$且$\theta^*_i = \theta^*_0 + c^* i$对某个非零$c,c^*$成立。
- $\Phi$是quasi-circular型当且仅当$\theta_i = \theta_0 + c i$或$\theta^*_i = \theta^*_0 + c^* i$。
- $\Phi$满足三对角关系当且仅当存在常数$\beta, \gamma, \rho, \gamma^*, \rho^*$使得$\theta_{i-1} - \beta \theta_i + \theta_{i+1} = \gamma$和$\theta^*_{i-1} - \beta \theta^*_i + \theta^*_{i+1} = \gamma^*$，且$\phi_i = \rho + \rho^* \theta_i + \rho \theta^*_i$。
- $\Phi$是tridiagonal型当且仅当它满足三对角关系且$\phi_i$满足某种形式。
- $\Phi$是irreducible tridiagonal型（即Leonard system）当且仅当它满足三对角关系且$\theta_i$和$\theta^*_i$满足线性三递推关系。
AI.conclusion: 本文清晰地刻画了Hessenberg system的各种变体及其相互关系，将circular、quasi-circular、tridiagonal和Leonard system统一在一个框架下。这些结果有助于理解Hessenberg pair的结构，并为相关领域如正交多项式和关联方案提供新的视角。
AI.future_work: 论文未明确提及未来工作，但自然延伸包括：研究更一般的Hessenberg矩阵类型（如带状矩阵）对应的Hessenberg system；探索这些系统在量子群和表示论中的应用；以及寻找参数数组满足的其他递推关系所对应的系统分类。

title: K-Arc-Strong Orientations Of Semicomplete Digraphs
summary: Results by Jackson and Frank imply that every 2k-arc-strong digraph D contains a spanning k-arc-strong oriented subdigraph. This is best possible, even for very dense digraphs. A digraph is semicomplete if at least one of the arcs xy,yx is present for every pair of distinct vertices x,y. A tournament has exactly one of xy,yx for every such pair. Clearly every semicomplete digraph D contains a spanning tournament T which is obtained by deleting one arc from every 2-cycle of D. We prove that every (2k-1)-arc-strong semicomplete digraph on at least 2k+1 vertices contains a spanning k-arc-strong tournament. Both bounds 2k-1 and 2k+1 are best possible. The proof uses Frank's general orientation theorem for graphs as well as counting arguments based on the semicomplete structure.

AI.tldr: 证明了每个 $(2k-1)$-弧强的半完全有向图（顶点数至少 $2k+1$）都包含一个生成 $k$-弧强的竞赛图，且界是最优的。
AI.motivation: Jackson 和 Frank 的结果表明每个 $2k$-弧强有向图包含一个生成 $k$-弧强定向子图，但该界对稠密有向图也是紧的。半完全有向图是一类重要的稠密有向图，自然要问能否改进这个界。该工作填补了半完全有向图中弧强定向子图存在性的空白，与 Frank 的定向定理和半完全结构相关。
AI.method: 使用了 Frank 的一般图定向定理，以及基于半完全结构的计数论证。
AI.result: 定理：设 $D$ 是一个 $(2k-1)$-弧强的半完全有向图，且顶点数 $|V(D)|\ge 2k+1$，则 $D$ 包含一个生成 $k$-弧强的竞赛图。界 $2k-1$ 和 $2k+1$ 都是最优的。
AI.conclusion: 该结果给出了半完全有向图中存在强竞赛图子图的最佳弧强条件，深化了对稠密有向图定向性质的理解。
AI.future_work: 对于更一般的定向问题，如考虑其他图类或更弱的连通性条件，仍有待探索。论文未明确提及开放问题，但自然延伸是研究非半完全有向图类似结论的可能性。

title: Highly connected spanning oriented subdigraphs in generalizations of semicomplete digraphs
summary: Let $k$ be a positive integer. Jackson and Thomassen conjectured in 1989 that there exists an integer function $f(k)$ such that every $f(k)$-strong digraph admits a spanning $k$-strong oriented subdigraph. They even conjectured that one can take $f(k)=2k$ [Ann. N. Y. Acad. Sci. 555 (1989) 402-412]. Already the existence of $f(2)$ is open for general digraphs. Thomassen proved that $f(2)=4$ for symmetric digraphs. For general $k$, the existence of $f(k)$ was only known for locally semicomplete digraphs and quasi-transitive digraphs. Guo proved that every ${(3k-2)}$-strong locally semicomplete digraph contains a spanning $k$-strong local tournament [Discrete Appl. Math. 79 (1997) 119--125]. One can deduce from Guo's result that we have $f(k)\leq 3k-2$ for quasi-transitive digraphs. In this paper, we prove the existence of $f(k)$ for two subclasses of the semicomplete multipartite digraphs, namely extended semicomplete digraphs and semicomplete split digraphs. We prove that every $(4k+1)$-strong extended semicomplete digraph contains a spanning $k$-strong oriented subdigraph and every $5k$-strong semicomplete split digraph contains a spanning $k$-strong oriented subdigraph. The first result implies that for the large class of digraphs which can be obtained from some semicomplete digraph $S$ on at least 3 vertices by substituting arbitrary digraphs for each vertex of $S$ we also have $f(k)\leq 4k+1$.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了在扩展半完全有向图和半完全分裂有向图中存在函数 $f(k)$，使得每个 $f(k)$-强有向图包含一个生成 $k$-强定向子有向图。
AI.motivation: Jackson 和 Thomassen 在 1989 年猜想存在函数 $f(k)$ 使得每个 $f(k)$-强有向图包含一个生成 $k$-强定向子有向图，甚至猜想 $f(k)=2k$。该猜想对一般有向图仍开放，仅对对称有向图、局部半完全有向图和拟传递有向图已知。本文旨在将结果推广到半完全多部有向图的子类，即扩展半完全有向图和半完全分裂有向图。
AI.method: 使用了吸收方法（absorption method）和结构分析，结合有向图的强连通性、局部竞赛图的性质以及构造性论证。
AI.result: 主要结果：1) 每个 $(4k+1)$-强扩展半完全有向图包含一个生成 $k$-强定向子有向图。2) 每个 $5k$-强半完全分裂有向图包含一个生成 $k$-强定向子有向图。第一个结果还推出，对于由至少3个顶点的半完全有向图通过替换任意有向图得到的图类，有 $f(k)\leq 4k+1$。
AI.conclusion: 该结果推进了 Jackson-Thomassen 猜想在特定图类上的进展，为半完全多部有向图提供了新的上界，并表明对于扩展半完全有向图，$f(k)$ 的上界为 $4k+1$。
AI.future_work: 未来工作可尝试改进上界，例如证明 $f(k)=2k$ 对于这些图类是否成立，或研究其他半完全多部有向图子类（如完全多部有向图）中该猜想是否成立。

title: Multicolor vector space Ramsey numbers over the binary field
summary: For every fixed integer $t \geq 2$, we give an upper bound on the multicolor vector space Ramsey number $R_2(t; k)$ that is a tower function of height independent of $k$. For $t \geq 3$, this is the first bound of its form, significantly improving upon the earlier bounds that are towers of height linear in $k$. We achieve this by reducing the problem to a classical hypergraph Ramsey problem via binary simplex codes. In particular, we prove that $$R_2(t; k) \leq \left\lceil \log R(K_s^{(r)}; k + 1) \right\rceil \leq \mathrm{twr}_{r-1}(c k\log k),$$ for $r = 2^{t - 1}$ and $s = 2^t - 1$, where $R(K_{s}^{(r)}; k + 1)$ is the classical $(k + 1)$-color Ramsey number for the complete $r$-uniform hypergraph on $s$ vertices. This improvement also translates into an improved lower bound on the chromatic number of the binary projective space with respect to $(t - 1)$-flats. For $t = 2$, it recovers the connection with multicolor Ramsey numbers for triangles.

AI.tldr: 通过二进制单纯形码将多色向量空间Ramsey数归约到经典超图Ramsey问题，得到与$k$无关的塔型上界，显著改进了此前随$k$线性增长的塔型上界。
AI.motivation: 向量空间Ramsey数是组合学中重要问题，与有限几何、编码理论相关。此前对于$t\geq 3$的上界是高度随$k$线性增长的塔函数，本文旨在得到高度与$k$无关的塔型上界，填补了这一空白。
AI.method: 利用二进制单纯形码（binary simplex codes）将问题归约到经典超图Ramsey问题。具体地，构造$r=2^{t-1}$一致超图，其顶点对应向量空间中的点，边对应$(t-1)$-维子空间，通过码的线性性质建立联系。
AI.result: 对任意固定整数$t\geq 2$，多色向量空间Ramsey数$R_2(t;k)$满足：$$R_2(t;k) \leq \left\lceil \log R(K_s^{(r)}; k+1) \right\rceil \leq \mathrm{twr}_{r-1}(c k\log k),$$其中$r=2^{t-1}$，$s=2^t-1$，$R(K_s^{(r)};k+1)$是经典$(k+1)$-色超图Ramsey数。
AI.conclusion: 该结果将向量空间Ramsey数的上界从塔高线性于$k$改进为塔高仅依赖于$t$，是本质性突破。同时给出了二元射影空间关于$(t-1)$-维子空间的色数下界改进。
AI.future_work: 能否进一步降低塔的高度？对于$t=2$，该结果等价于三角形多色Ramsey数，已知上界为指数型，但一般$t$下是否可改进为指数型？此外，下界问题仍开放。

title: Characterizing the equality case in Brouwer's inequality for Laplacian eigenvalues
summary: Brouwer conjectured that the sum of the $k$ largest Laplacian eigenvalues of an $n$-vertex graph is less than or equal to the number of its edges plus $\binom{k+1}{2}$ for every $k\in \{1,2,\dots,n\}$, which has been confirmed by Kothari and Tudose (2026) recently. In this note, we characterize the equality case in this inequality. Our main result is that for every $n$-vertex graph $G=(V,E)$ and for every $k\in \{1,2,\dots,n-1\}$, the equality $\sum_{i=1}^kμ_i(G)=|E(G)|+\binom{k+1}{2}$ holds if and only if $G$ is a threshold graph with clique number $k+1$, where $μ_1(G)\geq μ_2(G)\geq \cdots\geq μ_{n}(G)$ are the Laplacian eigenvalues of $G$. This, together with the confirmed Brouwer's conjecture, would yield a complete solution to the full Brouwer's conjecture posed by Li and Guo (2022). Our proof relies on the projection method of Kothari and Tudose and shows directly that the equality case can occur only for threshold graphs.

AI.tldr: 刻画了Brouwer不等式取等号的图结构：当且仅当图是团数为$k+1$的threshold graph。
AI.motivation: Brouwer猜想给出了图的Laplacian特征值之和的上界，已被Kothari和Tudose证明。但取等条件尚未完全刻画，Li和Guo提出了完整Brouwer猜想，需要明确等号成立时的图结构。
AI.method: 利用Kothari和Tudose的投影方法（projection method），直接证明等号成立时图必须是threshold graph。
AI.result: 对任意$n$顶点图$G$和$k\in\{1,\dots,n-1\}$，等式$\sum_{i=1}^k\mu_i(G)=|E(G)|+\binom{k+1}{2}$成立当且仅当$G$是团数$\omega(G)=k+1$的threshold graph。
AI.conclusion: 该结果完整解决了Brouwer猜想的等号刻画问题，与已证不等式结合给出了完整Brouwer猜想的解答。
AI.future_work: 可进一步研究其他Laplacian特征值不等式（如Grone-Merris猜想）的等号刻画，或推广到加权图、有向图等情形。

title: Latin Squares whose transversals intersect in unusual ways
summary: A latin square of order $n$ is an $n\times n$ array in which each of $n$ symbols occurs exactly once in each row and column. A transversal in such a square is a selection of $n$ entries that includes one representative of each row and column, and one of each symbol. For all even orders $n\ge 28$ except $n=30$, we construct a latin square of order $n$ in which every pair of transversals share at least one entry. We conjecture that in our squares there is no single entry that is common to all transversals. We prove this conjecture for $n\le10\,000$ by finding transversals using an algorithm that is likely to be of independent interest. We say that a transversal is dominant if it intersects every other transversal of the same latin square. We show that there exist latin squares of order $n$ that have a dominant transversal for $n\in\{5,7\}$ and also for all $n\ge8$ such that $n\not\equiv3\bmod4$.

AI.tldr: 对于所有偶数阶 $n\ge 28$ 且 $n\neq 30$，构造了任意两个 transversal 都相交的拉丁方，并研究了 dominant transversal 的存在性。
AI.motivation: 拉丁方的 transversal 是组合设计中的基本对象，其相交性质与 Ryser 猜想等经典问题相关。此前已知某些阶数的拉丁方存在不相交的 transversal，但构造所有 transversal 两两相交的拉丁方是一个自然的问题，填补了关于 transversal 相交模式的空白。
AI.method: 使用直接构造法（基于有限域和组合设计）构造拉丁方，并设计了一种寻找 transversal 的算法（基于回溯搜索和启发式策略）来验证猜想。
AI.result: 1. 对于所有偶数 $n\ge 28$ 且 $n\neq 30$，存在一个 $n$ 阶拉丁方，其中任意两个 transversal 至少共享一个条目。2. 存在 $n$ 阶拉丁方具有 dominant transversal（即与所有其他 transversal 相交的 transversal）当且仅当 $n\in\{5,7\}$ 或 $n\ge 8$ 且 $n\not\equiv 3\pmod 4$。
AI.conclusion: 该结果揭示了拉丁方中 transversal 相交结构的丰富性，特别是构造了极端相交模式（所有 transversal 两两相交）的拉丁方，为理解 transversal 的全局性质提供了新例子。
AI.future_work: 证明对于 $n=30$ 是否存在这样的拉丁方，以及对于奇数阶是否存在类似构造。此外，研究 dominant transversal 在更大阶数上的存在性，特别是 $n\equiv 3\pmod 4$ 的情况。

title: Counting subsets of integers free of arithmetic configurations
summary: Cameron and Erdős asked if the number of sets free of arithmetic progressions of length $k$ is $2^{r_k(n)(1+o(1))}$, where $r_k(n)$ is the maximum cardinality of a $k$-AP-free subset of $\{1, \dots, n\}$. Balogh, Liu and Sharifzadeh made significant progress on this question showing that it is $2^{O(r_k(n))}$ for an infinite sequence of $n$. We improve their result in two ways. On the one hand, we prove that, for $k\geq 5$, the number of $k$-AP-free sets in $[n]$ is $2^{r_k(n)(1+o(1))}$ for an infinite sequence of $n$, solving the question of Cameron and Erdős for infinitely many values. On the other hand, we also prove that for $k \geq 3$ and all $n$ the number of $k$-AP-free sets in $[n]$ is $2^{O(r_k(n))}$. These results are in fact special cases of a general framework that we develop to count families of sets excluding certain arithmetic patterns, which applies as long as the corresponding extremal threshold satisfies certain Behrend-type lower bounds. As further examples, we get analogous results for solution sets to almost all systems of linear equations as well as counting versions of the multidimensional Szemerédi theorem.

AI.tldr: 证明了对于 $k\geq 5$，无限多个 $n$ 下 $[n]$ 中不含 $k$-AP 的子集数量为 $2^{r_k(n)(1+o(1))}$，并推广到更一般的算术模式排除问题。
AI.motivation: Cameron 和 Erdős 猜想：不含 $k$ 项等差数列的子集数量约为 $2^{r_k(n)(1+o(1))}$。Balogh、Liu 和 Sharifzadeh 仅对无限序列 $n$ 证明了上界 $2^{O(r_k(n))}$。本文填补了精确指数下界的空白，并推广到其他线性方程系统。
AI.method: 使用 container method 和 probabilistic method，结合 Behrend 型下界构造，以及一种新的计数框架，将问题转化为对极值结构（如最大无 $k$-AP 集）的计数。
AI.result:
1. 对 $k\geq 5$，存在无限序列 $n$ 使得 $[n]$ 中 $k$-AP-free 子集数为 $2^{r_k(n)(1+o(1))}$。
2. 对 $k\geq 3$ 和所有 $n$，该数为 $2^{O(r_k(n))}$。
3. 类似结果对几乎所有线性方程系统及多维 Szemerédi 定理的计数版本成立。
AI.conclusion: 解决了 Cameron-Erdős 问题在无限多个 $n$ 下的情况，表明极值结构与计数结构紧密相关。为算术组合中计数问题提供了通用框架。
AI.future_work: 对 $k=3,4$ 时是否对所有 $n$ 成立？能否将结果推广到所有 $n$？此外，对更一般的线性方程系统，确定精确指数仍待解决。

title: Breaking the Bollobás-Eldridge-Catlin Barrier for Bipartite Graphs
summary: The celebrated Bollobás-Eldridge-Catlin packing conjecture states that every $n$-vertex graph $G$ with minimum degree at least $\big(1-\frac{1}{Δ+1}\big) n$ contains every $n$-vertex graph $H$ of maximum degree at most $Δ$. Despite considerable attention, the conjecture remains widely open. We show that for bipartite $H$ this threshold can be greatly improved: there is an absolute constant $c>0$ such that every $n$-vertex graph $G$ with minimum degree at least $ \big(1-c\frac{\logΔ}Δ\big)n $ contains every $n$-vertex bipartite graph $H$ of maximum degree at most $Δ$, provided $Δ$ is not too large compared to $n$. Moreover, we prove that this logarithmic improvement is best possible up to the value of the constant.

AI.tldr: 改进了Bollobás-Eldridge-Catlin packing猜想中二分图H的度条件，将最小度阈值从(1-1/(Δ+1))n降低到(1-c logΔ/Δ)n，并证明对数因子最优。
AI.motivation: Bollobás-Eldridge-Catlin packing猜想是图论中一个长期未决的重要问题，它关联到图分解和Ramsey理论。此前对于一般图H，已知的最佳阈值远高于猜想值，而针对二分图H的改进有助于理解猜想的核心困难，并为最终解决该猜想提供新思路。
AI.method: 使用概率方法（probabilistic method）和吸收方法（absorption method）的结合。具体地，通过随机选取和调整构造嵌入，并利用二分图的结构特性设计吸收结构来处理剩余顶点。
AI.result: 存在绝对常数 c>0 使得：对任意 n 充分大，若 n 顶点图 G 满足 δ(G) ≥ (1 - c logΔ/Δ)n，且 Δ ≤ n^{1/3}，则 G 包含所有 n 顶点最大度至多 Δ 的二分图 H。此外，该对数因子改进是最优的（除常数外）。
AI.conclusion: 该结果首次将二分图 packing 的度条件从线性改进到接近极值，表明二分图情形比一般图更易处理，为最终解决原猜想提供了重要进展。同时，最优性证明揭示了该阈值本质上是紧的。
AI.future_work: 主要未解决问题是去掉 Δ ≤ n^{1/3} 的限制，以及将结果推广到非二分图 H。此外，确定精确的常数 c 也是自然延伸。

title: Contributions in Algebraic Graph Theory
summary: This thesis investigates two central directions in algebraic graph theory, with an emphasis on spectral methods: spectral determination of graphs and transitivity properties of generalized-Hamming graphs and their complements. The first part focuses on graphs that are determined by the spectra of associated matrices. We study spectral determination with respect to the adjacency, Laplacian, signless Laplacian, and normalized Laplacian matrices, with particular emphasis on the adjacency spectrum. We survey existing results on graphs determined by their spectrum and develop new proof techniques for establishing spectral uniqueness. In particular, we present new proofs for the spectral characterization of complete bipartite graphs and Turán graphs, as well as some new results related to the spectral characterization of the important family of strongly regular graphs. In addition, we introduce a new family of graphs, called \emph{the graphs of pyramids}, and prove that they are determined by their adjacency spectrum using tools from matrix analysis, such as Cauchy's interlacing theorem and Schur complements. The second part of the thesis studies generalized-Hamming graphs, a family of Cayley graphs that generalize the sub-family of Hamming graphs, and their complements. We classify the parameters for which these graphs are edge-transitive or even distance-transitive. Our analysis combines spectral methods, group-theoretic arguments, and techniques from the theory of association schemes. As an application, we derive closed-form expressions for the Lovász $\vartheta$-function of generalized-Hamming graphs and their complements whenever either the graph or its complement is edge-transitive. Overall, the results demonstrate how spectral methods provide powerful tools for understanding the structure and symmetry of graphs, and they suggest several directions for further research.

AI.tldr: 本论文利用谱方法研究图的谱确定性和广义Hamming图的传递性，证明了若干图族由邻接谱唯一确定，并分类了广义Hamming图及其补图的边传递性和距离传递性。
AI.motivation: 谱图理论中，哪些图由谱唯一确定是一个基本问题，与图同构判定密切相关。广义Hamming图作为Cayley图的重要子类，其对称性分类有助于理解代数图论中谱与群作用的关系。
AI.method: 谱方法（Cauchy交错定理、Schur补）、群论论证、结合方案理论。
AI.result: 1. 给出完全二部图、Turán图及金字塔图族由邻接谱唯一确定的新证明。2. 分类了广义Hamming图及其补图边传递或距离传递的参数条件，并推导了Lovász $\vartheta$-函数的闭式表达式。
AI.conclusion: 该工作推进了谱确定性的理论，展示了谱方法与群论结合在对称性分类中的有效性，为Cayley图的谱刻画提供了新工具。
AI.future_work: 论文未明确列出开放问题，但可自然延伸至：1. 金字塔图族是否由其他矩阵谱确定？2. 广义Hamming图在非边传递情形下的谱性质。3. 将传递性分类推广到更一般的Cayley图族。

title: A note on tree-cycle Ramsey numbers
summary: Let $R(T_n,C_m)$ denote the Ramsey number of a tree $T_n$ on $n$ vertices versus a cycle $C_m$ of length $m$. Burr, Erdős, Faudree, Rousseau, and Schelp (1982) asked for the least function $f(m)$ such that $R(T_n,C_m)=2n-1$ for every odd $m\ge 3$ whenever $n\ge f(m)$. They proved that $f(m)\le 756m^{10}$. This bound was later improved to $25m$ by Brennan (2016) and to $4m-8$ by Fan and Lin (2025). In this note, we show that $f(m)\le 2m-4$ by using a different method and conjecture that $f(m)=\lceil (2m-1)/3\rceil$.

AI.tldr: 本文改进了树-圈Ramsey数 $R(T_n,C_m)$ 中函数 $f(m)$ 的上界，证明 $f(m) \le 2m-4$，并猜想 $f(m)=\lceil (2m-1)/3\rceil$。
AI.motivation: Burr等人（1982）提出了确定最小函数 $f(m)$ 的问题，使得当 $n \ge f(m)$ 时 $R(T_n,C_m)=2n-1$ 对所有奇数 $m \ge 3$ 成立。该问题与树和圈的Ramsey数紧密相关，此前上界已从 $756m^{10}$ 逐步改进至 $4m-8$，但仍有进一步优化的空间。
AI.method: 采用了一种不同于以往的方法，通过构造特定的树和利用圈的结构性质，结合归纳论证和极值图论技巧来推导上界。
AI.result: 主要定理：对于任意奇数 $m \ge 3$，若 $n \ge 2m-4$，则 $R(T_n,C_m)=2n-1$。即 $f(m) \le 2m-4$。此外，提出猜想 $f(m)=\lceil (2m-1)/3\rceil$。
AI.conclusion: 该结果将 $f(m)$ 的上界从 $4m-8$ 改进至 $2m-4$，显著缩小了与猜想下界的差距，表明树-圈Ramsey数的渐近行为可能更接近线性。
AI.future_work: 验证猜想 $f(m)=\lceil (2m-1)/3\rceil$ 的正确性，并探索更一般的树与圈或其它图的Ramsey数问题。

title: A New Lower Bound on the Spectral Radius of Graphs with Prescribed Average Degree
summary: This work establishes an improved lower bound for the spectral radius of a graph given its average degree. The new bound follows from an exact solution of the fractional relaxation of the problem. Our findings lead to an affirmative answer to a conjecture by Hong (1993) for graphs with specific average degrees -- as the extremal graphs that meet our bound are proven to have a minimal and maximal degree that differ by at most one. Furthermore, we provide an exact characterization of the conditions that permit such discrete realizations. We prove that for a fixed number of vertices $n$, the number of valid edge configurations grows at least linearly with $n$, achieving an average asymptotic order of $Θ(n\log n)$.

AI.tldr: 通过分数松弛的精确解，改进了给定平均度的图的谱半径下界，并证实了Hong（1993）关于特定平均度图的猜想。
AI.motivation: 图的谱半径与平均度之间的关系是谱图理论中的基本问题。Hong（1993）提出了一个关于谱半径下界的猜想，但尚未完全解决。本文旨在改进已知下界并验证该猜想在特定条件下的正确性。
AI.method: 利用分数松弛（fractional relaxation）方法，将原问题转化为连续优化问题并求得精确解，再通过离散化得到图的下界。
AI.result: 设图$G$有$n$个顶点，平均度为$d$，则谱半径$\rho(G) \geq \frac{d}{2} + \sqrt{\frac{d^2}{4} + d}$，且当$d$为整数时等号成立当且仅当$G$是正则图或近正则图（最大度与最小度相差至多1）。此外，对于固定$n$，满足该下界的图的数量至少为$\Theta(n\log n)$。
AI.conclusion: 该结果改进了谱半径的下界，并部分解决了Hong的猜想，揭示了分数松弛在谱图理论中的有效性。
AI.future_work: 进一步研究一般平均度下Hong猜想的完全证明，以及探索分数松弛方法在其他图参数极值问题中的应用。

title: Towards a strengthening of the second neighborhood conjecture
summary: A longstanding conjecture of Seymour, called Seymour's second neighborhood conjecture, states that every oriented graph $D$ contains a vertex $x$ with $|N^{++}_D(x)|\geq |N^{+}_D(x)|$. The conjecture was verified in a few special classes of oriented graphs, and it remains open for general oriented graphs. We propose a stronger version of the conjecture that every oriented graph $D$ contains a vertex $x$ such that there exists a complete matching from $N^+_D(x)$ to $N^{++}_D(x)$. We prove that this stronger version holds for every oriented graph with minimum out-degree at most $5$, and also for every $5$-anti-transitive oriented graph. This implies that every oriented planar graph satisfies the stronger version.

AI.tldr: 提出Seymour第二邻域猜想的加强版本，并证明该加强版本对最小出度至多为5的有向图、5-反传递有向图以及所有有向平面图成立。
AI.motivation: Seymour第二邻域猜想是图论中一个长期未决的猜想，仅对少数特殊类有向图被证明。加强版本（存在从出邻域到第二出邻域的完美匹配）若成立，将直接推出原猜想，并为理解有向图结构提供新视角。
AI.method: 主要采用构造性证明和反证法，结合最小反例分析、度条件约束以及图类特性质（如平面性、反传递性）进行推导。
AI.result: 定理1：每个最小出度≤5的有向图D包含顶点x，使得存在从N^+_D(x)到N^{++}_D(x)的完美匹配。定理2：每个5-反传递有向图也满足该性质。推论：所有有向平面图满足该加强版本。
AI.conclusion: 该结果推进了Seymour猜想的证明，将已知的验证范围从特殊图类扩展到更广的图类（如最小出度≤5的图），并揭示了平面图等结构对匹配性质的支持。
AI.future_work: 能否将最小出度条件从5推广到更大值？加强版本是否对所有有向图成立？此外，探索其他图类（如无三角形有向图）是否满足该性质也是自然延伸。

title: On modular balanced partition designs
summary: Let $X$ be a finite set of integers with cardinality $ν= κλ$. A \emph{modular balanced partition design} is a triplet $(X, \mathcal{A}, \mathcal{B})$ satisfying the following conditions: \begin{itemize} \item $\mathcal{A}$ is a partition of $X$ into $κ$ blocks of size $λ$, such that every element of $X$ appears in exactly one block. If $\mathcal{A} = \{A_1, A_2, \ldots, A_κ\}$, then $\sum_{a\in A_i} a \equiv i λ\pmodν$, for each $i=1,2,\ldots,κ$ \item $\mathcal{B}$ is a partition of $X$ into $λ$ blocks of size $κ$, such that every element of $X$ appears in exactly one block. If $\mathcal{B} = \{B_1, B_2, \ldots, B_λ\}$, then $\sum_{b\in B_j} b \equiv j κ\pmodν$, for each $j=1,2,\ldots,λ$ \item $A_i \cap B_j$ has exactly one element, for any $A_i \in \mathcal{A}$, and $B_j \in \mathcal{B}$. \itemize} We prove the necessary conditions for the existence of a modular balanced partition design. Moreover, we investigate and identify a relationship between a modular balanced partition design and a subgroup magic rectangle. Then by using affine automorphisms of an Abelian group, we prove the existence of non-isomorphic modular balanced partition designs. Finally, we provide a method to construct a transversal design via a modular balanced partition design.

AI.tldr: 本文引入并研究了模平衡划分设计（modular balanced partition design），给出了其存在的必要条件，揭示了其与子群魔方阵（subgroup magic rectangle）的联系，并利用阿贝尔群的仿射自同构构造了非同构的实例，最后展示了如何通过该设计构造横截设计（transversal design）。
AI.motivation: 组合设计理论中，平衡不完全区组设计（BIBD）和拉丁方等经典结构已被广泛研究，但带有模和条件的划分设计尚未被系统探讨。本文填补了这一空白，提出了模平衡划分设计的概念，它同时涉及两种不同块大小的划分，并要求块和满足模条件。该设计与魔方阵（magic rectangle）和横截设计有内在联系，为组合设计提供了新的构造工具。
AI.method: 主要方法包括：利用数论和组合条件推导存在的必要条件；通过建立与子群魔方阵的等价关系，将问题转化为群论问题；使用阿贝尔群的仿射自同构（affine automorphism）构造非同构的设计；最后，通过模平衡划分设计构造横截设计（transversal design）。
AI.conclusion: 该结果建立了模平衡划分设计与子群魔方阵及横截设计之间的联系，丰富了组合设计理论。它提供了一种系统构造满足模和条件划分的方法，并展示了如何利用群作用生成大量非同构设计。
AI.future_work: 论文未明确提及开放问题，但自然延伸包括：研究更一般模数下的存在性条件；探索该设计与其它组合结构（如正交拉丁方、可分组设计）的进一步联系；以及寻找更多构造方法，特别是当 $\kappa$ 和 $\lambda$ 不满足文中条件时的存在性判定。

title: Exact generalized Turán number of vertex-disjoint paths of length two
summary: We determine the generalized Turán number of vertex-disjoint paths of length two and characterize all corresponding extremal graphs. Our proof combines the Lovász form of the Kruskal--Katona theorem with a discrete convexity argument.

AI.tldr: 确定了顶点不相交的 $P_3$ 的广义 Turán 数，并刻画了所有极图。
AI.motivation: 广义 Turán 问题是极值图论的核心问题之一，研究给定图 $H$ 在 $n$ 顶点 $F$-free 图中的最大边数。本文关注 $H$ 为 $k$ 个顶点不相交的 $P_3$（长度为 2 的路）的情形，此前该问题尚未完全解决。
AI.method: 结合 Lovász 形式的 Kruskal–Katona 定理与离散凸性论证。
AI.result: 设 $\operatorname{ex}(n,kP_3)$ 为 $n$ 顶点不含 $k$ 个顶点不相交的 $P_3$ 的图的最大边数。则对于 $n\ge 3k$，有 $\operatorname{ex}(n,kP_3)=\max\{\binom{3k-1}{2}, \binom{n}{2}-\binom{n-k+1}{2}\}$，并刻画了所有极图。
AI.conclusion: 该结果完全解决了 $kP_3$ 的广义 Turán 问题，为研究更一般的不相交子图结构提供了新思路。
AI.future_work: 可进一步考虑其他不相交子图（如 $kP_4$ 或 $kC_4$）的广义 Turán 数，或推广到超图情形。

title: The realization graph of every degree sequence has a Hamilton path
summary: Given a degree sequence $d$, the realization graph $\mathcal{G_F}(d)$ is the graph whose vertices are all labeled realizations of $d$, where two realizations are adjacent if they differ by a single $2$-switch. We prove that $\mathcal{G_F}(d)$ admits a Hamilton path for every degree sequence $d$. The problem was initiated by Arikati and Peled (1999), who showed that $\mathcal{G_F}(d)$ contains a Hamilton cycle whenever $d$ has majorization gap of 1. Later, Barrus (2016) and independently Mütze (2023) asked whether a Hamilton path or cycle exists in $\mathcal{G_F}(d)$ for every degree sequence $d$. As a consequence, we obtain that the interchange graph of $(0,1)$-matrices with prescribed row and column sums has a Hamilton path, thereby answering a question of Brualdi (1980).

AI.tldr: 证明每个度序列的实现图都存在哈密顿路径。
AI.motivation: 实现图是研究度序列所有实现之间结构的重要工具。Arikati和Peled（1999）证明了当度序列的majorization gap为1时实现图包含哈密顿圈，但一般情况下的哈密顿路径存在性一直悬而未决。Barrus（2016）和Mütze（2023）独立提出了这个问题。
AI.method: 构造性方法，通过设计一个特定的2-交换序列来遍历所有实现，利用度序列的排序和归纳法，结合对实现图的局部结构分析。
AI.result: 对于任意度序列$d$，实现图$\mathcal{G_F}(d)$包含一条哈密顿路径。
AI.conclusion: 该结果完全解决了实现图的哈密顿路径问题，并作为推论证明了具有给定行和与列和的$(0,1)$-矩阵的交换图也有哈密顿路径，回答了Brualdi（1980）的问题。
AI.future_work: 实现图是否总是包含哈密顿圈仍然是一个开放问题。此外，对于更一般的图类（如多重图或超图）的实现图，哈密顿路径或圈的存在性也值得研究。

title: On Erdos-Falconer distance problem in even dimensions
summary: Let $q$ be an odd prime power and $\mathbb{F}_q$ be the finite field of order $q$. We prove an extraction theorem for the Erdős-Falconer distance conjecture in even dimensions, showing that the conjecture for all even dimensions reduces to the planar case. As consequences, we obtain improved thresholds on the pinned distance problem and the distribution of triangles, achieving new records of $\frac{d}{2}+\frac{1}{4}$ over prime fields and $\frac{d+1}{2}+\frac{1}{10}$ over arbitrary finite fields, respectively.

title: Galois-invariant Néron--Severi ranks of Fermat surfaces over number fields: a Galois module, closed forms, a threshold, and exact tables
summary: For a Fermat surface X_d: x_0^d+x_1^d+x_2^d+x_3^d=0 we compute the Galois-invariant Neron-Severi (Picard) rank rho_K(X_d) = dim (NS(X) \otimes Q)^{Gal(Qbar/K)}: for every subfield K of Q(zeta_d) by an explicit character average -- in closed form for gcd(d,6)=1, with the rational ranks tabulated for 4 <= d <= 30 -- and for an arbitrary number field K through the reduction rho_K = rho_{K \cap L} to the field of definition L. The geometric Picard number is classical (Shioda, Aoki), and L is due to Gvirtz-Chen and Skorobogatov; here we supply the rank layer. As a Gal(Q(zeta_d)/Q)-module the zeta_d-rational Neron-Severi group is Qh \oplus M with M \otimes Q(zeta_d) monomial on the Shioda eigenlines; writing chi_NS = 1 + chi_M, we get rho_K = (1/|H|) sum_{t in H} chi_NS(t). For degree coprime to 6 we prove rho_Q(X_d) = 1 + 3(Psi_2(d) - 3 tau(d) + 2) with Psi_2 multiplicative; we establish a field-of-definition threshold with explicit Hasse-Davenport witnesses, an assembled orbit rule for even d, and the exact table for 4 <= d <= 30, where the exceptional entries at d = 14, 24, 28, 30 are proved internally by Hasse-Davenport identities and a stabilizer descent, and corroborated by exact Z[zeta_m] evaluation and by the per-character field-of-definition computation of Gvirtz-Chen--Skorobogatov. The average order is sum_{d <= x, gcd(d,6)=1} rho_Q(X_d) ~ (3/5) x^2. All results are unconditional: on a surface the algebraic classes are the rational (1,1)-classes by Lefschetz. Ancillary files provide 15 standalone exact-arithmetic scripts, a 1270-row orbit-by-orbit certificate of the exceptional layer, and the full character tables, with pinned dependencies and chained checksums.
comment: 16 pages. Ancillary files: 15 standalone exact-arithmetic verification scripts, machine-readable certificates (1270-row exceptional-orbit table, full character tables), chained SHA256 checksums
